enGuide: Defeat Stayen. Watch the apprentice priest's long-range item healing.

simpleJp: BATTLE 2-3「悪魔討伐部隊」を5ターン耐える
jpGuide1:
BATTLE〖悪魔討伐部隊〗
クレイスには手を出さず、誰も戦闘不能にならないように5ターン耐えろ！
enGuide: Survive 5 turns. Avoid engaging Kreis and keep everyone alive.

simpleJp: BATTLE 2-4「闇にうごめく者」で敵を全滅させる
jpGuide1:
BATTLE〖闇にうごめく者〗
この変な奴らを全部倒せばいい
enGuide: Defeat all enemies. Their attack power is high and several use bows, so watch party HP.

simpleJp: BATTLE 2-5「黒き翼のアベル」でアラギを倒す
jpGuide1:
BATTLE〖黒き翼のアベル〗
目的は、アベルではなくアラギを倒すこと
enGuide: Defeat Aragi. When the boss activates a Pain Ring, nearby demons can make powerful ranged attacks. The ring 「ささやく精霊」 also carries useful healing magic worth learning.
